newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech AgMin says gene maize shipment must stop.
newsitem.headline: Czech AgMin says gene maize shipment must stop.

text.p: The Czech Agriculture Ministry on Friday said a shipment of U.S. feed maize, believed to contain genetically-manipulated strains, must be halted until further study on the potential effects of the grain is completed.

Frantisek Havir, director of the ministry's agriculture production section, told reporters that the Institute for Agricultural Production would conduct the study on so-called "gene maize" as soon as possible, and that until the study was finished, no maize would be distributed in the Czech Republic.
